_doc: P7a contract §5.3 (V2xx) and §5.13 RQ12 / RQ13 (Area A; AM-P7a-16): the V2 gate decision table.

Each row: name; ingest = the slack-ingest.json row whose envelope is sent (its expectFacts become p_ingest: nulls omitted, booleans and numbers kept, dd_paths only when non-empty; a row with expectDerive null goes to v2 with p_ingest null, the P6 path); state = what to seed on top of base; send: once (default) | twice (a Slack retry, retry_num 1) | again (the same envelope with event_id + 'X').

base: the installation (fixed id) with a live reading half and the nine scopes, slack_reading_enabled on, the DD bot row, the opted-out authors, the FB lead list (fb_onboarding) and every channel of slack-ingest.json's catalogue.

state keys: installation (reading: none | discovering, or column overrides), settings (column overrides), channels ({ id: overrides of the catalogue entry | null to remove }), messages / items / threads / markers (rows by channel and ts), attention (fingerprints), optouts, ddBot (false = none), fb (missing = no fb_onboarding table, empty = no list).

expect: v2's answer and the normalized snapshot after the event (pid →

; job dedupe keys' minute / hour buckets → *). SQL (RQ12, every engine) and fake-slack-read-db.ts (RQ13, slack-read-gate.test.ts) must both equal it.
Rows without a channel row change list nothing new; a drop writes nothing (C6).
